intro: Kosovo's economy is small and relies heavily on money from relatives abroad.

chapters.title: Coal, farms and remittances
text: Kosovo has large reserves of lignite coal, which produces most of its electricity. Money sent home by Kosovars working abroad is a vital source of income, and many young people struggle to find jobs.

chapters.title: The future
text: Since 2024 Kosovars have been able to travel to most EU countries without a visa, a long-awaited change.

cardGroups.title: Made in Kosovo
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Kosovo makes and sells to the world.
